# Paying down debt: avalanche or snowball

Rebalance the portfolio once a year rather than reacting to every market headline. Track net worth quarterly; the trend matters more than any single month. The avalanche method pays the highest interest debt first and saves the most money. A monthly review compares planned and actual spending by category and adjusts next month.

## Steps

- A sinking fund spreads a known future cost, such as a new laptop, across the months before it.
- Automate savings on payday so the money moves before it can be spent.
- An emergency fund of three to six months of essential costs covers most surprises.

## Open questions

Index funds win mostly on fees; a one percent fee compounds into a large loss over decades. Track net worth quarterly; the trend matters more than any single month. The snowball method pays the smallest balance first and builds motivation with quick wins.
